description: Golden queries for self-correcting RAG — citation, metric, and geography checks. evidence_fixtures are synthetic snippets used by offline eval (not live retrieval).

cases.query: What share of Maharashtra GSDP comes from the services sector in the latest available year?

evidence_fixtures.text: In 2017-18, Maharashtra's service sector contributed 54.5% of GSDP and was described as the largest sector.
According to DES Maharashtra, services contributed 64.27% to GSDP in 2024-25 (advance estimates).

cases.good_answer_example: Maharashtra services contributed 64.27% of GSDP in 2024-25 [e5f6a7b8], up from 54.5% in 2017-18 [a1b2c3d4].

cases.query: What is Maharashtra's GDP growth rate?

evidence_fixtures.text: Maharashtra GSDP grew 7.6% in 2023-24 at constant prices. National GDP growth was 8.2%.

cases.good_answer_example: Maharashtra does not publish 'GDP'; state output is GSDP, which grew 7.6% in 2023-24 [b2c3d4e5].

cases.query: Compare Maharashtra's 2017-18 GSDP sector composition (54.5% services) with the latest available data for agriculture, industry, and services.

evidence_fixtures.text: 2017-18: agriculture 11%, industry 34.5%, services 54.5% of Maharashtra GSDP.
2024-25: agriculture 9.8%, industry 25.9%, services 64.27% of Maharashtra GSDP.

cases.good_answer_example: In 2017-18 Maharashtra services were 54.5% of GSDP [c3d4e5f6]; by 2024-25 services rose to 64.27% while industry fell to 25.9% and agriculture to 9.8% [d4e5f6a7].

cases.query: What was India's GDP growth in FY2023-24?

evidence_fixtures.text: India's real GDP grew 8.2% in FY 2023-24 according to MoSPI provisional estimates.

cases.good_answer_example: India's real GDP grew 8.2% in FY 2023-24 [f6a7b8c9].

cases.query: What is Maharashtra's GVA in manufacturing?

evidence_fixtures.text: Maharashtra manufacturing GVA was ₹4.2 lakh crore in 2022-23 at current prices. State GSDP was higher because it includes net taxes.

cases.good_answer_example: Maharashtra manufacturing GVA was ₹4.2 lakh crore in 2022-23 [a7b8c9d0].

cases.query: Is the latest Maharashtra GSDP figure an advance estimate or actual?

evidence_fixtures.text: Maharashtra GSDP 2024-25 figures are First Advance Estimates and subject to revision.

cases.good_answer_example: The 2024-25 Maharashtra GSDP figures are First Advance Estimates [b8c9d0e1].

cases.query: Report Maharashtra GSDP growth at constant prices.

evidence_fixtures.text: Maharashtra GSDP growth at constant (2011-12) prices was 7.6% in 2023-24; at current prices growth was 11.2%.

cases.good_answer_example: At constant (2011-12) prices, Maharashtra GSDP grew 7.6% in 2023-24 [c9d0e1f2].

cases.query: What is Maharashtra services share of GSDP?

evidence_fixtures.text: Services were 64.27% of Maharashtra GSDP in 2024-25.

cases.bad_answer_example: Maharashtra services are about 64% of GSDP in the latest year.
cases.good_answer_example: Services were 64.27% of Maharashtra GSDP in 2024-25 [d0e1f2a3].

cases.query: Cite the services share of Maharashtra GSDP.

evidence_fixtures.text: Services 64.27% of GSDP (Maharashtra, 2024-25).

cases.good_answer_example: Services were 64.27% of GSDP [e1f2a3b4].
